notes.li: Welcome to Magic Framework: a growing spellcasting foundation for magical colonies, enchanted gear, battlefield rituals, and first-party magic content.

New spells can now feel more complete in play, with clearer spell details, better scaling, smoother maintained effects, reliable projectiles, lingering magic zones, summons, traps, teleports, shields, auras, and terrain-changing magic.
Magic effects are built to behave consistently across saves, so delayed blasts, chained lightning, wards, fields, and summoned creatures should feel dependable instead of mysterious in the bad way.
Settings: you can tune spell text, caster scaling, and diagnostic logging from Magic Framework settings.

Stay tuned: future updates are planned to improve spell presentation, expand the authoring guide, support richer magical items, and eventually let hostile spellcasters bring magic to enemy encounters.
You can reopen the latest notes from the Magic Framework settings page.
